title: Spectrum embedding for arbitrary multiplicative localization
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $M\subseteq A$ a multiplicative subset, meaning $1\in M$ and $st\in M$ whenever $s,t\in M$. Let $B=M^{-1}A$ be the ring of fractions $a/s$, with equality $a/s=b/t$ when some $u\in M$ satisfies $u(at-bs)=0$. The canonical map $h:\operatorname{Spec}B\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], sending a prime to its inverse image under $a\mapsto a/1$, is a topological embedding. Its image is exactly $\{\mathfrak p:\mathfrak p\cap M=\varnothing\}$; equivalently it is a homeomorphism onto this subset with the subspace topology.
